analytics.name: Analytic 1762
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Asymmetric Cryptography from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App writes asymmetric-encrypted blob or encoded ciphertext to local staging path before network transmission — encrypted staging artifact]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: VPN clients, enterprise secure messaging, MDM agent, apps with documented asymmetric crypto need (certificate-pinned enterprise apps). Derive from MDM catalog.

analytics.name: Analytic 1763
analytics.guidance: Indirect evidence of asymmetric cryptographic channel usage inferred through key exchange-like network patterns and application background execution behavior, where direct observation of keypair operations is limited. Detection correlates app entitlement posture + background execution + asymmetric handshake patterns + subsequent encrypted communication.
